about: Daily Zoloft (L018) covers 3 June when a single intramuscular Toradol dose (L019) is recorded.
Daily Lexapro (L035) overlaps twice-daily Naprosyn (L038) from 11 to 24 February.
During Zoloft treatment the only NSAID supplies are Voltaren Emulgel for the skin (L019) and Acular eye drops (L020).
